# PDF.js for local CV text extraction

Version: 6.5.438 of pdfjs-dist.
License: Apache-2.0, see LICENSE.
Source archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.5.438.tgz

The two minified browser files are unmodified package builds. They are loaded only when a visitor chooses a PDF. CV files and extracted text remain on the visitor's device. The checker does not render PDF pages or execute embedded PDF scripts.
